english.title: Possess self loading / pump action smooth-bore gun
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the authority of the Secretary of State, had in your possession

(A)_[a self-loading]_
(B)_[a pump-action]_

smooth-bore gun, namely **(..SPECIFY TYPE OF SMOOTH-BORE GUN..), which was not an air weapon or chambered for 0.5588 centimetres (.22) rim-fire cartridges and
(C)_[had a barrel less than 60.96 centimetres (24 inches) in length]_
(D)_[was less than 101.6 centimetres (40 inches) in length overall]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(1)(ac) of, and Schedule 6 to, the Firearms Act 1968.

english.notes:
(i) Any detachable, folding, retractable or other movable butt-stock is disregarded when measuring the length of the firearm, see section 5(8).
(ii) Measurements expressed in metric terms following EC Directive on Units of Measurement which came into force on 1st January 1995 and the Units of Measurement Regulations 1995 which came into force on 1st October 1995.
(iii) See also offence wordings: H6129, H6130 and H6131.
(iv) On conviction for this offence, the court can order the forfeiture or disposal of any firearm or ammunition and cancellation of any firearm certificate or shot gun certificate, and any firearm or ammunition subject of such order may be seized or detained by a constable (section 52 of the Firearms Act 1968).

other.penalty:
Indictment: maximum 10 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

A minimum sentence may apply to this offence, see section 311 of, and Schedule 20 to, the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
